response.sql: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id), store_avg AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM rental_totals GROUP BY store_id) SELECT t.store_id, SUM(t.total) AS total_payment_sum, AVG(t.total - s.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM rental_totals t JOIN store_avg s ON s.store_id = t.store_id WHERE t.total > s.avg_total GROUP BY t.store_id

assumptions.assumption: The store average is computed over all of that store's rentals that have at least one linked payment (rentals with no payments are not counted as zero-total rentals).
A payment is linked to a rental when rental_id is non-null and matches an existing rental, whose inventory copy gives the store.
